novel.justification: This is an explicitly chosen finite-experiment regularity restriction, not a condition attributed to Chernozhukov, Chetverikov, and Kato. In a known-covariance experiment the extremal eigenvalues are computable before outcomes are analyzed; reporting results over a prespecified band excludes nearly deterministic and explosively noisy directions, while sensitivity over candidate values of \(\sigma_{\min}\) and \(\sigma_{\max}\) gives a direct calibration interpretation.
